## lighting

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lighting.asset` | text |  | Reusable lighting asset; inline values remain the fallback if it is missing. |
| `lighting.light_direction` | x y z | `[8.0,16.0,8.0]` | Where the directional light shines from, aimed at the origin. |
| `lighting.light_color` | color | `#FFFFFF` |  |
| `lighting.illuminance` | number | `10000.0` | Lux the directional light emits - 10_000 is bright daylight. |
| `lighting.ambient_color` | color | `#FFFFFF` |  |
| `lighting.ambient_brightness` | number | `80.0` |  |
| `lighting.ao_enabled` | switch | `false` | Screen-space ambient occlusion on the 3D camera. Off by default: it costs GPU time and changes the look of existing projects. |
| `lighting.shadow_map_size` | whole number from 0 | `2048` | Shadow map size per cascade, in pixels. Must be a power of two; larger is crisper and hungrier. Bevy's own default is 2048. |
| `lighting.shadow_bias` | number | `0.019999999552965164` | Depth bias fighting shadow acne. Small positive values lift the shadow off the surface; too much makes shadows detach. The normal bias stays at Bevy's own default. |
| `lighting.shadows` | record |  |  |
| `lighting.shadows.filter` | one of `Hardware`, `Gaussian`, `Temporal` | `Gaussian` |  |
| `lighting.shadows.distance` | number | `150.0` | Metres from the camera the sun's shadows reach. `set shadow distance to` overrides it for a run. |
| `lighting.shadows.cascades` | whole number from 0 | `4` | Sun shadow cascades, 1-4. More keeps near shadows sharp over a long distance. |
| `lighting.shadows.first_cascade` | number | `5.0` | Where the first cascade ends, in metres. The rest split the remaining distance logarithmically. |
| `lighting.shadows.cascade_blend` | number | `0.20000000298023224` | How much neighbouring cascades overlap, 0-0.5, so the step between them fades rather than snaps. |
| `lighting.shadows.fade` | number | `0.10000000149011612` | The last part of the distance, 0-0.5 of it, over which the sun's shadows fade out instead of ending at a line. |
| `lighting.shadows.normal_bias` | number | `1.7999999523162842` | Normal bias for the sun, pushing the lookup out along the surface to fight acne on slopes. The depth bias is `Lighting::shadow_bias`. |
| `lighting.shadows.sun_size` | number | `0.0` | Soft sun shadows (PCSS) as if the sun were this many degrees across; 0 keeps them hard. The real sun is about 0.5. |
| `lighting.shadows.contact` | switch | `false` | Screen-space contact shadows: a short raymarch against the depth buffer under feet and clutter. The sun takes part; each light opts in. |
| `lighting.shadows.contact_length` | number | `0.30000001192092896` | Metres a contact shadow ray travels. |
| `lighting.shadows.contact_thickness` | number | `0.10000000149011612` | How thick the depth buffer is taken to be, in metres. |
| `lighting.sun_cookie` | text |  | An image the sun shines through, tiled across the world like cloud shadows or a canopy. Only its red channel counts. Empty for none. |
| `lighting.sun_cookie_size` | number | `20.0` | Metres one tile of the sun's cookie covers. |
| `lighting.ray_tracing` | record |  |  |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.enabled` | switch | `false` | Off by default: it needs a ray-tracing GPU and costs a lot of it. |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.bounces` | whole number from 0 | `3` | Most bounces a light path takes, 1-8. `set GI bounces to` overrides it for a run. |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.samples` | whole number from 0 | `8` | Light samples per pixel at the first hit, 1-32. `set GI samples to` overrides it for a run. |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.denoiser` | one of `Auto`, `Restir`, `Filter`, `None` | `Auto` |  |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.gi_distance` | number | `50.0` | Metres a bounced-light ray reaches before it gives up. |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.mode` | one of `Hybrid`, `PathTraced` | `Hybrid` |  |
| `lighting.ray_tracing.paths` | whole number from 0 | `1` | Paths per pixel each frame when path traced, 1-16. |

## fog

Height fog, volumetric fog and aerial perspective, 3D only.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fog.height` | record |  | **Height fog** |
| `fog.height.enabled` | switch | `false` | **On** |
| `fog.height.base_height` | number (m) | `0.0` | **Base** Used when `enabled` is set. World height where the fog is as thick as `distance` says. |
| `fog.height.falloff` | number 0 to 10 (/m) | `0.05000000074505806` | Used when `enabled` is set. Per metre: how fast it thins going up. 0 is the same everywhere. |
| `fog.height.distance` | number 0.1 to 10000000 (m) | `400.0` | **See through** Used when `enabled` is set. Metres of fog at the base that swallow 95% of what is behind it. |
| `fog.height.start` | number from 0 (m) | `0.0` | **Starts at** Used when `enabled` is set. Metres from the camera before any fog starts. |
| `fog.height.day_color` | color | `#C2CAD2` | **Day** Used when `enabled` is set. The fog's color with the sun high, low and gone. |
| `fog.height.dusk_color` | color | `#E8A778` | **Dusk** Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `fog.height.night_color` | color | `#2A3344` | **Night** Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `fog.height.sun_boost` | number 0 to 100 | `0.5` | **Sun glow** Used when `enabled` is set. Extra glow looking towards the sun, as a fraction of its light. |
| `fog.height.sun_boost_g` | number 0 to 0.99 | `0.75` | **Sun glow g** Used when `enabled` is set. How tight that glow is, 0-0.99. |
| `fog.volumetric` | record |  | **Volumetric fog** |
| `fog.volumetric.enabled` | switch | `false` | **On** |
| `fog.volumetric.density` | number 0 to 10 (/m) | `0.019999999552965164` | Used when `enabled` is set. Extinction per metre at the base height. |
| `fog.volumetric.base_height` | number (m) | `0.0` | **Base** Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `fog.volumetric.falloff` | number 0 to 10 (/m) | `0.10000000149011612` | Used when `enabled` is set. Per metre going up, as for height fog. |
| `fog.volumetric.anisotropy` | number -0.9 to 0.9 | `0.6000000238418579` | **g** Used when `enabled` is set. Henyey-Greenstein g, -0.9 to 0.9: positive glows towards the light. |
| `fog.volumetric.albedo` | color | `#FFFFFF` | Used when `enabled` is set. How much of what it stops it scatters, per channel. |
| `fog.volumetric.emissive` | color | `#000000` | **Glow** Used when `enabled` is set. Glow of its own, for neon smog. |
| `fog.volumetric.emissive_strength` | number from 0 | `0.0` | **Glow nits** Used when `enabled` is set. Nits of the emissive color at a density of 1 per metre. |
| `fog.volumetric.noise` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` | Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1: how much noise carves the fog. |
| `fog.volumetric.noise_scale` | number 0.1 to 10000 (m) | `12.0` | Used when `enabled` is set. Metres across one noise feature. |
| `fog.volumetric.noise_wind` | x y z (m/s) | `[1.0,0.0,0.5]` | **Drift** Used when `enabled` is set. Metres per second the noise drifts. |
| `fog.volumetric.range` | number 4 to 2000 (m) | `96.0` | Used when `enabled` is set. Metres from the camera the grid covers. |
| `fog.volumetric.quality` | one of `Low`, `Medium`, `High` | `Medium` | Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `fog.volumetric.sun` | switch | `true` | **Sun & moon** Used when `enabled` is set. Whether the sun and moon light it. Each light has its own switch. |
| `fog.volumetric.ambient` | number 0 to 100 | `1.0` | Used when `enabled` is set. Multiplier on the ambient light it scatters. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust` | record |  | **Height dust** Dust motes hanging in the air near the ground around the camera, whether or not the froxels are on. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.enabled` | switch | `false` | **On** |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.count` | whole number 0 to 4096 | `600` | Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.size` | number 0.001 to 1 (m) | `0.012000000104308128` | Used when `enabled` is set. Metres across one mote. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.alpha` | number 0 to 1 | `0.6000000238418579` | Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1 opacity at full light. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.twinkle` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` | Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1: how much each mote flickers. |
| `fog.volumetric.dust.drift` | number 0 to 10 (m/s) | `0.05000000074505806` | Used when `enabled` is set. Metres per second each mote wanders. |

| `fog.aerial` | record |  | **Aerial haze** |
| `fog.aerial.enabled` | switch | `false` | **On** |
| `fog.aerial.distance` | number 1 to 10000000 (m) | `8000.0` | **Half gone** Used when `enabled` is set. Metres at which half of a far object's own light is gone. |
| `fog.aerial.tint` | color | `#FFFFFF` | Used when `enabled` is set. The haze's color where there is no sky to take it from, and a tint on the sky's where there is. |
| `fog.aerial.desaturation` | number 0 to 1 | `0.4000000059604645` | **Gray** Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1: how gray far things turn. |
| `fog.aerial.height_scale` | number 1 to 100000 (m) | `1200.0` | **Height** Used when `enabled` is set. Metres over which the haze thins going up, so peaks stay crisp. |
| `fog.aerial.blue_shift` | number 0 to 1 | `0.699999988079071` | **Blue** Used when `enabled` is set. How much more blue fades than red, 0 gray to 1 fully Rayleigh. |

## surface

Snow cover and wetness, which surface masks scale by.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface.snow` | number | `0.0` | Snow cover, 0 (none) to 1 (everything flat enough is white). |
| `surface.wetness` | number | `0.0` | Wetness, 0 (dry) to 1 (soaked). |

## vfx

The particle budget and where emitters simulate.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vfx.budget` | whole number from 0 | `200000` | Live particles the whole world may hold. Emitters past it stop spawning until some die. |
| `vfx.cpu_only` | switch | `false` | Forces every emitter onto the CPU pool: headless and low-end targets. |

## cutscenes

Named camera reels that `play cutscene` runs on the wall clock.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cutscenes` | list of record | `[]` | Named camera reels that `play cutscene` runs on the wall clock. |
